Mina — thank you for sharing and for the heads-up. I'm sorry to see you go but appreciate your offer to help with transition. Can you meet with me and Lauren tomorrow at 11am PT for a quick plan?

Immediate items we'll cover:
- Handoff of active projects and on-call notes
- Equipment return window and access cutoff windows
- Any severance/compensation questions (I'll loop in payroll/legal)

I'll start a formal sundown checklist and loop in HR Ops and Payroll to ensure final pay and benefits are clear.

— Soojin

Date: 2026-08-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Action needed: final pay + severance coordination for Mina Haddad (last day Aug 20)

Hi Runway team — looping you in to coordinate final payroll and severance for Mina Haddad (employee ID 7842), whose last day will be 2026-08-20. Please see the sundown checklist attached (sundown-access-checklist.xlsx) and the proposed severance term sheet (mina_severance_term_sheet.pdf).

Key asks:
1) Confirm final paycheck date (including unused PTO) and severance payment schedule.
2) Provide instructions for any payroll paperwork you need from Mina (I will copy her below).
3) Confirm whether health benefits continuation (COBRA or local equivalent) paperwork will be sent automatically or needs an action item.

DocuSign link to the term sheet is below; if you need a different flow let me know.

Drive folder with checklist and artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSundownPlan
DocuSign link: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345&v=3

Thanks — please reply with timing by EOD tomorrow so we can confirm with Mina and Lauren.

— Soojin
From: Runway Payroll Support <support@runwaypayroll.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action needed: final pay + severance coordination for Mina Haddad (last day Aug 20)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the details. We can do the final pay on the next scheduled payroll run following the termination date (pay date 2026-08-25). Severance can be issued as a separate off-cycle payment; we can schedule that for 2026-08-30 if Redwood approves.

We need the following from Mina for the severance pay setup:
- Last 4 of SSN or country tax ID equivalent
- Confirm mailing address for any tax forms
- Completed direct deposit form if different from current on file

We will also generate benefits continuation paperwork and send it within 5 business days after termination. Please confirm whether the severance is taxable at source (yes/no) and attach the signed term sheet.

— Runway Support
Attachment: payroll_questionnaire_form.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-10T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sundown plan: final pay, access cutoff, equipment return — confirmed schedule

Team / Mina — final schedule and actions confirmed below: 

- Final day: 2026-08-20 (remote).
- Final payroll (regular wages + PTO): pay date 2026-08-25 (Runway).
- Severance payment (one-time off-cycle): scheduled for 2026-08-30, pending Mina's signed term sheet.
- Access cutoff (accounts & VPN): 2026-08-21 11:59 PM PT. Emergency exceptions require sign-off from Markus.
- Equipment return: ship back hardware by 2026-08-22 (prepaid label will be provided by IT).
- DocuSign: please sign the term sheet via the link in the Drive. Mina — Runway needs the last 4 of your SSN and a confirmation of mailing address; please send securely to Monica and Runway Support only.

Attachments referenced: sundown-access-checklist.xlsx, mina_severance_term_sheet.pdf.

If there are any objections to these dates (Markus / Lauren), please reply today so we can adjust. Otherwise we'll proceed and I will update the offboarding ticket in Workday and the Drive folder.

Thanks,
— Soojin
